response.text:
I can’t change folder permissions from here (no permission tools available). I also need to flag that the folder contains budgets and salary planning — those are highly sensitive. Exposing them to all employees can create privacy, compliance, and morale risks, so please confirm you intend to proceed and that you have authority to make the change.

Before I give specific steps, two quick clarifying questions:
1) Which storage system is this in (Google Drive, SharePoint/OneDrive, Box, Dropbox, internal file server)?  
2) Do you want “view-only” for all employees, or full edit rights?

What I can do now
- Provide step-by-step instructions for changing folder visibility on the platform you use.
- Draft an approval request or notification message for stakeholders (finance leadership, HR, IT/security).
- Recommend safer alternatives (redact salary files, create a public summary, move sensitive files to restricted subfolder).

Immediate safety checklist (recommend doing these before making visible to all)
- Remove or move files that contain individual salaries or personally identifying payroll details to a restricted folder.
- Create a public summary (aggregated budget numbers) if full details aren’t needed company-wide.
- Notify HR and Legal/Compliance and obtain sign-off if required by policy or local law.
- Consider DLP or access logging so any access is auditable.

Quick how-to (common platforms)

Google Drive (change folder to all employees with view-only)
1. Sign in to Google Drive as an owner or admin.  
2. Right‑click the Finance/Forecasts folder → Share.  
3. Click “Change to anyone with the link” or (better) click “Share with people and groups” and add your company-wide group (e.g., everyone@yourcompany.com or a Google Group that contains all employees).  
4. Set permission to “Viewer” (not Editor).  
5. Uncheck “Editors can change permissions and share” if you added editors.  
6. Click Send / Done.  
7. Notify stakeholders and keep a copy of the previous sharing settings for rollback.

SharePoint / OneDrive (change folder library permissions)
1. Go to the site/library where the Finance/Forecasts folder lives.  
2. Select the folder → click the vertical ellipsis (…) → Manage access (or Details → Manage access).  
3. If the folder inherits permissions, break inheritance (Stop Inheriting Permissions) to edit folder-level access.  
4. Grant access to the company-wide group (e.g., Everyone except external users) and set permission level (Read).  
5. Save and optionally check “Show items to all users” if needed.  
6. Notify stakeholders and document changes.

Box
1. Owner navigates to the folder → Settings → Collaboration.  
2. Add the company-wide group with Viewer role.  
3. Save and notify.

If you tell me which platform and your answers to the two questions above, I’ll:
- Give exact step-by-step instructions tailored to your environment, or
- Draft an approval/notification message for finance, HR, and IT that you can send to get the change approved, or
- Draft the precise admin-console command/instructions for your IT admin to run.

Which would you like me to prepare next?
